name: UniVoxel
definition: A unified voxelization framework for explicit learning of scene representations that encodes a scene into latent volumetric representations to efficiently model geometry, materials, and illumination jointly for inverse rendering.
summary: UniVoxel is a unified voxelization framework for inverse rendering that encodes scenes into learnable SDF and semantic voxel fields, avoiding expensive visibility simulations by integrating illumination directly into the grid.
